description.zh: 用途：按项目语言维护第一方 Skill 与文档。 不适用：未经授权的上游改写或缺少语言约定却直接翻译。 这是可选择的行为偏好，不代表普遍最优做法。
description.en: Use: maintaining first-party Skills and docs in the project language. Not for: unauthorized rewrites of upstream material, or translating without an agreed language. This is a selectable behavior preference, not a universally best practice.
